task: Approved ORR, metro, traffic, landmark map and national-flag improvements

changes.orr: Local rendering/support of long streamed roads, four through lanes per carriageway, shoulders and auxiliary tapers, ramp-connected barrier openings, gradual bridge approaches, curve-following advance/exit gantries with verified interchange labels, and same-carriageway recovery.
changes.metro: Normalize the six source paths into three paired corridors and six fixed directional tracks; share rail/train geometry, maintain following distance and platform occupancy, articulate coaches and avoid visible terminal jumps.
changes.traffic: Continuous vehicle-specific curves for road bends, junctions, lane changes and supported U-turns; curvature speed limits, wider bus turns, whole-body clearance and occupancy. A varied subset of autos makes quicker safe maneuvers; ORR traffic remains in through lanes. Final QA closes a rectangular bus nose/tail corner gap using the full oriented static footprint and height-aware barrier intersections.
changes.map: All 191 modeled places share stable map/model identities, searchable categories and architectural/category silhouettes, with zoom clustering and touch hit regions. Map selection preserves the car and delivery.
changes.landmarks: Bounded source-supported geometry/pose/color corrections to Charminar, Jagannath Temple, Central Gurudwara Saheb, Telangana Thalli and Buddha; all 191 models have geometry/metadata audits.
changes.flag: Equal stripes in a 3:2 rectangle and centered navy 24-spoke Ashoka Chakra visible on both cloth faces.
changes.healthway: Covered cycleway source features render at grade with a low solar canopy, rather than a false elevated skywalk. Explicit bridges and tunnels keep their separate treatment.

preservation.orrAlignment: All 28,054 original vertices retained in order. Added collinear vertices improve grade sampling without changing the source alignment.

steps: Play, select Kokapet and accept Sri mahalaxmi family dhaba pickup.
Use visible W/A/D/S, map checkpoints and Space flight/landing to reach the ORR near the Exit 1 Kokapet 250 m gantry.

intermediateBuildReproductions.sourceCause: The old ground recovery helper excluded motorways. Game.watchStuck triggered it after the stuck interval, allowing a service-road destination.

intermediateBuildReproductions.observation: The covered Healthway cycle track appeared as an elevated blue skywalk alongside the ORR.

intermediateBuildReproductions.confidence: High for rendered feature/source-classifier mismatch; all 22 unique Healthway ways lack explicit bridge/layer/tunnel elevation tags.
